{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Growth", "construction": "calculate the 3-year growth rate of research and development expenses as reported in the income statement, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing R&D expenses may be undertaking innovative and risky projects, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "calculate the difference between the current year's inventory turnover and the 3-year average inventory turnover, using Compustat data", "rationale": "An increase in inventory turnover may indicate improving operational efficiency, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense-to-Assets Ratio", "construction": "calculate the ratio of advertising expenses to total assets, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high advertising expenses may be investing in intangible assets, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "calculate the 3-year growth rate of the number of employees, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing employment may be expanding into new markets or increasing their market share, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "R&D Expense-to-Assets Ratio", "construction": "calculate the ratio of research and development expenses to total assets, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high R&D expenses may be undertaking innovative and risky projects, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure-to-Assets Ratio", "construction": "calculate the ratio of capital expenditures to total assets, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high capital expenditures may be investing in new projects or expanding their operations, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Growth Rate", "construction": "calculate the 3-year growth rate of accounts payable, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing accounts payable may be taking on more supplier credit, which can indicate improving operational efficiency.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Receivable Growth Rate", "construction": "calculate the 3-year growth rate of accounts receivable, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing accounts receivable may be experiencing increasing sales or taking on more customer credit, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Property, Plant, and Equipment Growth Rate", "construction": "calculate the 3-year growth rate of property, plant, and equipment, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing property, plant, and equipment may be expanding their operations or investing in new projects, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Other Current Assets Growth Rate", "construction": "calculate the 3-year growth rate of other current assets, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing other current assets may be investing in new projects or expanding their operations, which can lead to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
